Using the incidence equations:

\[
2B + D = 30
\]
\[
2G + D = 40
\]

Subtract:

\[
2G - 2B = 10 \Rightarrow G - B = 5 \Rightarrow G = B + 5
\]

Given \(B = \frac{2}{3}G\):

\[
B = \frac{2}{3}(B+5)
\]
\[
3B = 2B + 10
\]
\[
B = 10
\]

Then \(G = 15\). Thus:

\[
D = 30 - 2B = 30 - 20 = 10
\]

\[
\boxed{10}
\]
